evals.prompt: 6 người bạn đi Tam Đảo thứ 7-CN tuần sau, budget 2 triệu/người, muốn villa có bể bơi gần Hà Nội. Lên kế hoạch và xuất file Excel.
evals.expected_output: Confirms inputs, compares ≥5 stays, waits for user pick (or documents pick in eval run), writes docs/tam-dao-trip-planning.md and asks for review, and only after approval exports docs/tam-dao-trip.xlsx filled from assets/trip-template.xlsx with VND costs and the Tam Đảo itinerary.
expectations: Weather or season information is included for Tam Đảo
Draft docs/tam-dao-trip-planning.md exists with the sections Thông tin chung, Tiền tệ, Itinerary, Checklist and Summary, written before any workbook
No .xlsx or Google Sheet is created until the user approves the draft, and the .xlsx is saved under docs/, not in a temporary folder
Workbook values match the approved draft
At least five accommodation options with price, rating, and booking link
Workbook is an .xlsx with exactly three sheets named Itinerary, Checklist and Summary
Formula cells (Itinerary F3, Checklist G3, L10 and L11) still hold formulas and Itinerary K8 holds the headcount 6
Thông tin chung on the Checklist sheet has Điểm đến Tam Đảo, the travel dates, Budget/người as the number 2000000 and the selected villa with its booking link
Every Checklist line has a tick box value (☐ or ☑) in column A
Cost estimate includes transport and a contingency buffer
Workbook is a filled copy of the bundled template, not a workbook rebuilt from scratch

evals.prompt: Mình và người yêu chưa biết đi đâu, 3 ngày 2 đêm, khoảng 5 triệu/người, thích onsen hoặc tắm khoáng. Gợi ý và lập kế hoạch chi tiết.
evals.expected_output: Suggests 3–5 destination fits, user narrows choice, compares stays, builds couple-focused itinerary and a workbook filled from the template (.xlsx, or Google Sheets when a Sheets tool is connected).
expectations: Offers multiple destination ideas before locking one
Compares stays with pros/cons suited to couples
Itinerary is not over-packed for a 2-night trip
Budget per person is tracked against the 5M target
Workbook generated from the template with its three sheets: Itinerary, Checklist and Summary
Thông tin chung holds the destination the user settled on, Số đêm 2 and Budget/người 5000000 as numbers, and leaves unknown rows empty
Writes the docs/*-trip-planning.md draft and waits for approval before creating any workbook

evals.prompt: Gia đình 2 người lớn + 1 bé 4 tuổi đi Đà Lạt 2 đêm, 3.5 triệu/người, cần chỗ free cancellation. Plan trip giúp mình.
evals.expected_output: Family-aware lodging search, free-cancellation called out, gentle itinerary, workbook from the template, chat summary whose preparation list includes child items.
expectations: Lodging options mention cancellation policy or free cancellation
Itinerary accounts for a young child (pace, activities)
Chat summary preparation list (Chuẩn bị) includes family-relevant packing or prep items
Does not skip weather check for Đà Lạt dates
Does not create final workbook before a stay is selected
Stops after writing the draft and asks the user to review it; a requested change is made in the same docs/*-trip-planning.md file, not a new copy

evals.prompt: Nhóm 4 người đi Hong Kong 4 ngày 3 đêm giữa tháng 12, bay từ Hà Nội, budget 15 triệu/người. Lên plan chi tiết rồi xuất ra ggsheet giúp mình nhé.
evals.expected_output: Plans the trip, then delivers Google Sheets because the user named it: a filled copy of the template uploaded with conversion or built natively, or, with no Sheets or Drive tool connected, the .xlsx plus how to open it in Google Sheets.
expectations: Writes docs/hong-kong-trip-planning.md and gets approval before creating the Google Sheet
Chooses Google Sheets as the format because the user asked for ggsheet
With no Sheets or Drive tool available, delivers the .xlsx filled from the template and says how to open it in Google Sheets
Workbook has exactly three sheets named Itinerary, Checklist and Summary
Itinerary J4 is HKD with an exchange rate in K4, and the rate's date is stated
Checklist includes a Dự phòng line, and flights appear as a Checklist line, not as a per-leg fare in Itinerary column E
Checklist column A holds ☐ or ☑ on every line; real check boxes are set up, or the user is told how, when the deliverable is Google Sheets
Thông tin chung has Điểm đến Hong Kong, Số đêm 3 and Budget/người 15000000 as numbers, Chỗ nghỉ with the nightly price and its currency, and Lưu ý with the exchange rate and its date
Cost per person in the chat summary equals the per-person total the workbook computes
